cc:Work.dc:title: Synthetic closed-loop delivered-query utility
cc:Work.dc:description: Points are mean per-scenario expected utility divided by the scenario's DP optimum; bars are pointwise 95% percentile intervals. 10,000 crossed seed × scenario resamples after averaging four latent paths. Five seeds limit training-variability inference; realized query draws are not used here. The primary is the eight-mode CT-RNN trained to the paired RR CPU budget. Synthetic heldout scenarios do not establish a production future window.
